text: The Blaupunkt brand belongs to Established. Inc., a US brand-licensing company backed by Ares Management and Crosstimbers Capital Group, which acquired the Blaupunkt trademark portfolio from GIP Development SARL (an AURELIUS entity) in June 2023.
short: Blaupunkt is owned by Established. Inc., a US licensing company backed by Ares and Crosstimbers.

source.name: AURELIUS: 'GIP Development sells Blaupunkt brand'
source.quote: GIP Development SARL, an AURELIUS entity, announces the disposal of the Blaupunkt brand to Established. (USA), a private equity backed brand licensing company with broad industry expertise globally.

additionalSources.name: Carlsquare: deal note on the sale of the Blaupunkt trademark portfolio to Established. incorporated
additionalSources.quote: Blaupunkt, an iconic German brand, has been acquired by Established. incorporated (Established.), a global licensing company backed by Ares Management and Crosstimbers Capital Group.
